CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content is present.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), its presentation/organization (coordinate set) and a separate origin/status field are all explicitly present and bound to p0/current/n1.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to an identified content's organization/access.

C.rationale: Identifies colored content (red) with explicit coordinate set.

D.rationale: Separately attributes an origin/status object to the identified content p0/current/n1, distinguishing identity from status/access metadata.

O.rationale: States how the content is presented (explicit coordinate grouping / spatial organization).
